the_letter.name: A Letter from Julie
the_letter.description:
The letter looked a hundred years old. Auntie Julie - a woman you were told you had, and never met - asked you to Castle for your birthday. Twelve hours on the Sunday train. No signal since the tunnel.

The map in the letter is one road from Castle Halt. It ends at a house and a dog.
the_letter.completion: The stoop is real. Julie is not on it. The dog has been waiting.

requirements.text: Auntie Julie's house, at the end of the station road

defeat_skeleton.name: The Thing in the Yard
defeat_skeleton.description: The dog wants the walking bones off Julie's fence line. It will not say why a key is waiting until they stay down.
defeat_skeleton.completion: The skeleton will not get up again today. The dog has decided you are allowed a key.

requirements.text: The bones walking Julie's fence line

see_the_kitchen.name: Julie's Kitchen
see_the_kitchen.description: The house key was always for you. Go in. Look at what she left out.
see_the_kitchen.completion: Auntie is not home. The house still is.

stock_the_bench.name: Dust, Water, Pansy
stock_the_bench.description: Julie's note says the bench is set for one potion and that you should make it before you go down any stairs. Gold dust, a vial of water, a pansy from the pantry chest. Stand at the bench and open your bags. The dog will want to know.
stock_the_bench.completion: It fizzes blue. You made that. The dog is not surprised.

requirements.text: A Manashield potion, made at the bench in Julie's kitchen

rats_below.name: What Snakes Eat
rats_below.description: There are rats in the cellar under Julie's kitchen, down either hatch. The dog wants three pieces of meat and will not say what for.
rats_below.completion: Soak it in Stranglethorn - water and snakeroot - at the bench. Throw it where a burial snake can smell it. Do not stand near.

requirements.text: Rat meat, from the rats in Julie's cellar

the_mine.name: Gnox Goldskin's Mine
the_mine.description: The Gold Mine is at the end of the mine road out of Castle; its mouth is the one with the lamp. The Headmaster keeps the vault key. Something called Iron Knuckles keeps everything else. Broken things down there want Repair, and Repair wants wood and iron.
the_mine.completion: The mine is quiet. Whatever Julie dug there, she stopped digging.

requirements.text: The Gold Mine, at the end of the mine road
The Headmaster, down the gold mine
Iron Knuckles, down the gold mine

the_burial.name: The Snake Below
the_burial.description: The burial chamber is past Castle, off the graveyard road: a footpath from the graveyard ends at a standing stone that says DO NOT. Cold, dark, foggy. Light the blue torches. Find what burns in the garden. Do not fight the small snakes; feed them.
the_burial.completion: The snake is still. Julie was never in its mouth. The county still turns.

requirements.text: The standing stone, on the footpath from the graveyard
The garden, inside the burial chamber
The big snake, in its own room in the burial chamber
